shared_elements: human figures shown in strict profile
elaborately curled/patterned hair and long beards
hands holding bowls or shallow dishes raised before the body
small vessel or flask held in the hand
figures aligned along a single horizontal register
low relief with incised interior detail
justification: Both depict bearded male attendants in profile with tightly patterned curled hair, long linear-folded robes, and bowls or small vessels held up in the hands, drawn in the same shallow relief with incised interior detail — a very specific offering-bearer scheme rather than a generic figure. The main difference in content is arrangement: A is a confronted pair of full-length figures facing each other across the vessels, while B is a unidirectional file of repeated bearers each wearing a close-fitting cap, with no confronted focus.
